Description:
Construct and analyze a dynamic customer–product transaction network using Pandas, NetworkX, TSFresh feature extraction, and PyOD anomaly detection.

import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import networkx as nx
from tsfresh import extract_features
from pyod.models.auto_encoder import AutoEncoder
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from datetime import datetime as dt

# 1. Load & merge
def load_data(trans_path: str, cust_path: str) -> pd.DataFrame:
    tx: pd.DataFrame = pd.read_csv(trans_path, parse_dates=['date'])
    cu: pd.DataFrame = pd.read_csv(cust_path)
    return tx.merge(cu, on='customer_id')

# 2. Build temporal graph edges
def build_graph(df: pd.DataFrame) -> nx.DiGraph:
    G = nx.DiGraph()
    for _,r in df.iterrows():
        G.add_edge(r['customer_id'], r['product_id'], date=r['date'])
    return G

# 3. TSFresh features per customer
def customer_features(df: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.DataFrame:
    df2 = df.rename(columns={'customer_id':'id'})
    feats = extract_features(df2, column_id='id', column_sort='date',
                             default_fc_parameters={'mean':None,'std':None})
    return feats.fillna(0)

# 4. Anomaly detection on feature space
def detect_anomalies(feat: pd.DataFrame) -> pd.Series:
    X = StandardScaler().fit_transform(feat)
    ae = AutoEncoder(hidden_neurons=[64,32,32,64], epochs=20, verbose=0)
    ae.fit(X)
    return pd.Series(ae.labels_, index=feat.index, name='anomaly')

# 5. Example run
if __name__=='__main__':
    df = load_data('transactions.csv','customers.csv')
    G = build_graph(df)
    feats = customer_features(df[['customer_id','date','amount']])
    anoms = detect_anomalies(feats)
    print("Graph nodes:", len(G.nodes()))
    print("Feature sample:\n", feats.head())
    print("Anomalies:\n", anoms.value_counts())
